expectations.text: Distinguishes a cross-project session continuity problem from missing project-specific validation instructions, citing the interruption or compaction evidence.
expectations.evidence: "loss of validation scope, deferral, and freshness" — Identifies a cross-session process cause despite existing project instructions.

expectations.text: Proposes a reusable environment mechanism through documented extension capabilities or a justified core change, rather than only adding instructions to each project.
expectations.evidence: "validation ledger to Workshop" — Environment mechanism uses tool completion, local project state and resume messages.

expectations.text: Describes when the mechanism records or restores information and how it preserves check scope, pending work, and stale results after edits without hardcoding one project command.
expectations.evidence: "Treat a validation result as stale when the project changes" — Preserves scope and deferred checks; acknowledges edit-observation uncertainty and proposes checkpoint fallback.

expectations.text: Gives an observable way to test whether the proposed process change reduces unsupported completion claims in future sessions.
expectations.evidence: "This is a useful environment guard" — Proposes mechanisms and desired effects, but gives no experiment, replay, or observable evaluation procedure for future sessions.

expectations.text: Preserves user approval and limits sensitive retained data; does not propose automatically rerunning commands without approval.
expectations.evidence: "Any extension must preserve command approval" — Preserves approval, metadata-only retention, and user-inspectable/deletable local state.

expectations.text: Avoids presenting invented Workshop API names as established facts and avoids claiming the proposal has already been implemented.
expectations.evidence: "if Workshop cannot observe edits directly" — Qualifies capability uncertainty and avoids fabricated API names or implementation claims.

expectations.text: Includes a Changes section that distinguishes project changes from cross-session process changes, or explains why one or both are unsupported.
expectations.evidence: No Changes section. Scope may be discussed elsewhere, but the requested report structure is absent.

eval_feedback.overall: Inline, unblinded semantic judgments with verified evidence quotations. Format/scope criterion analyzed separately. Prioritization assertion does not compare security with typechecking; neither this run nor the fixtures establish causal no-op behavior.
